<?php

/**
 * Hipster Ipsum for Alfred 5
 * Based on tofias' workflow gist: https://gist.github.com/tofias/9160634
 * (itself based on Seth Lilly's Hipster-Ipsum-for-Coda:
 *  https://github.com/sethlilly/Hipster-Ipsum-for-Coda)
 * Uses the Hipster Ipsum API by Jason Cosper: https://hipsum.co
 *
 * Keyword:  hipster [count] [format] [type]   (all optional, any order)
 *   count    number of paragraphs/sentences, 1-99   (default 1)
 *   format   paras | p | sentences | s              (default paras)
 *   type     centric | latin                        (default hipster-centric)
 *   baby     start the text with "I'm baby..."      (off by default)
 *
 * Examples
 *   hipster              1 paragraph, hipster-centric
 *   hipster 3            3 paragraphs
 *   hipster 5 sentences  5 sentences
 *   hipster 2 latin      2 paragraphs of hipster-latin
 *   hipster baby         1 paragraph starting with "I'm baby..."
 */

// Defaults
$COUNT  = 1;
$TYPE   = 'hipster-centric';
$FORMAT = 'paras';
$LOREM  = '';   // set to '&start-with-lorem=1' to begin with "I'm baby..."

// Alfred passes the typed keyword argument to this script as argv.
$query = trim(implode(' ', array_slice($argv, 1)));
foreach (preg_split('/\s+/', $query, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY) as $tok) {
    $t = strtolower($tok);
    if (ctype_digit($t)) {
        $COUNT = max(1, min(99, (int) $t));
    } elseif ($t === 's' || strncmp($t, 'sent', 4) === 0) {
        $FORMAT = 'sentences';
    } elseif ($t === 'p' || strncmp($t, 'para', 4) === 0) {
        $FORMAT = 'paras';
    } elseif (strncmp($t, 'lat', 3) === 0) {
        $TYPE = 'hipster-latin';
    } elseif (strncmp($t, 'cent', 4) === 0 || strncmp($t, 'hip', 3) === 0) {
        $TYPE = 'hipster-centric';
    } elseif ($t === 'baby' || strncmp($t, 'lorem', 5) === 0) {
        $LOREM = '&start-with-lorem=1';
    }
}

$res = file_get_contents("https://hipsum.co/api/?type=$TYPE&$FORMAT=$COUNT$LOREM");
$ret = json_decode($res);

// Join paragraphs/sentences and collapse double spaces after periods.
$hipsum = str_replace('  ', ' ', implode("\n\n", $ret));

echo $hipsum;

Type `hipster` followed by any of these — all optional, in any order:
- a number 1–99 (paragraph / sentence count) - `paras` or `sentences` - `centric` (default) or `latin` - `baby` — start the text with “I'm baby...”
e.g. `hipster 3 sentences baby`. The result is pasted into the frontmost app and copied to the clipboard.
Based on tofias' workflow gist (gist.github.com/tofias/9160634), itself based on Seth Lilly's Hipster-Ipsum-for-Coda. Text via the Hipster Ipsum API (hipsum.co) by Jason Cosper.
